players.product: Fiber array units (FAU) and silicon-photonics / co-packaged optics (CPO) optical packaging services, plus MPO fiber jumpers and passive optical components

quarterly_data.quarter: FOCI Fiber Optic Communications IR presentation: MOPS 336320260528E001 (06-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CPO progress (Q1 2026 earnings conference deck): the company reports >5 potential customers and >5 different MCM CPO packages delivered, and says multi-chip module CPO samples have been released. 2025 milestones: next-generation ReLFACon FAU for >1.6T, >3.2T and >6.4T, 20, 40 and 80 channels FAU, detachable CPO and MCM optical co-packaging (CPO). 2026 plan: next-generation ReLFACon beyond 6.4 T and wavelength division multiplexing (WDM); automatic production lines in progress - high-density FAU auto production line ramping up (20~80 channels) and a 2D FAU assembling trial production line.
quarterly_data.figure: >5 different MCM CPO packages delivered; >5 potential customers

quarterly_data.quarter: FOCI Fiber Optic Communications IR presentation: MOPS 336320260528E001 (06-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: SiPh FAU mass production plan (company deck): clean room and high-precision automated CPO FAU production lines under construction, followed by delivery of specified quantities of >1.6 and >3.2T FAU to the customer and then >6.4T FAU, on a schedule running from 2025/Q4 to 2027 & beyond. Bandwidth roadmap: 1.6T/3.2T/6.4T FAU with mass production lines under construction; 12.8T and beyond in R&D.
